mentions.name: Personal garden designer
mentions.description: This personal garden designer keeps track of a rose garden with over 100 roses and an orchard of about 15 trees, tailored to its creator's specific needs; it serves as the basis for a new general-purpose garden planner.
mentions.source_excerpt: It is based on a garden designer I made for myself to keep track of my rose garden (I have over 100 roses) and orchard (I have about 15 trees): https://garden.simonsarris.com/
